entities.name: Mitul
entities.description: Gifted vedalken artificer from Ghirapur on Avishkar.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: Elven inventor, Mitul's friend, abducted by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Villain who abducted Rashmi and used her invention.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: Renegade who took Rashmi into her care.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Rebel group Mitul and Rashmi built a skyship for.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Device Rashmi expanded from her portal design for Tezzeret and later sabotaged.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: Massive skyship completed by Mitul and Rashmi for the Renegades.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: Space surrounding Kaladesh studied in their research.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: Conflict during which Rashmi created the Planar Bridge.

events.summary: Mitul and Rashmi create a miniature planar portal; Rashmi wins the Inventors' Fair but is abducted by Tezzeret.
events.quote: With her invention, Rashmi won the Inventors' Fair but was abducted by Tezzeret .

events.summary: Rashmi sabotages her invention and escapes, taken in by Saheeli and the Renegades; Mitul is brought in later.
events.quote: Rashmi sabotaged her invention and escaped the aether lab

events.summary: Mitul and Rashmi complete Tezzeret's Ruin for the Renegades; Rashmi renames it the Heart of Kiran.
events.quote: At its inauguration, Rashmi renamed it the Heart of Kiran .
